title: A small request: Is anyone willing to help me get access to Claude Opus? ❤️
author: TeraDev1
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I hope you're all doing well.

I know this might be an unusual request, but I wanted to give it a try.

I've been really interested in using Claude Opus, especially for learning, programming, and working on personal projects. Unfortunately, I can't afford a subscription right now, and it's disappointing not being able to access a tool that could genuinely help me improve my skills.

I'm not asking anyone to feel obligated. I just wanted to ask if there's someone kind enough who has an extra opportunity, a spare access option, or would be willing to help me get access for free.

Even a little help would honestly mean a lot to me.

Thank you for taking the time to read this. ❤️
